wiki.title: Stephen Webber
wiki.extract: Stephen Webber (born June 8, 1983) is an American politician. He is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 19th district, serving since 2025. He previously represented the 46th district in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2009 to 2017. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
